## Problem and result

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue using `Closes #NUMBER` when appropriate.

## Verification

Provide relevant checks, observed results and evidence for the acceptance criteria.

## Decisions and limitations

Record agreed tradeoffs, known limitations and any documentation or deployment changes.

## Review

- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria are demonstrated.
- [ ] Code comments and docstrings are in English.
- [ ] All commits and the PR title follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] No secrets, unauthorized assets or large generated files are included.
- [ ] The user has reviewed the result before merge.
